name: Slow Fall
body:
Design manipulation (gravity); Level 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 immediate action

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one Medium or smaller free-falling object or creature/level, no two of which may be more than 20 ft. apart
Duration until landing or 1 round/level
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless) or Will negates (object); Spell Resistance yes (object)

DESCRIPTION

The affected creatures or objects fall slowly. This functions as a feather fall spell, except as noted here.

Overload: For every runic charge overloaded into this script, the duration increases by 1 round, and you may target an additional two creatures or objects.
